title: DSH Mobile Relay v1 frames
description: Strict challenge, heartbeat, commands, scoped session reads and negotiated feature frames. Metadata requires session.metadata.v1 plus explicit metadata_version=1 and independent session.metadata.read; legacy catalog and model catalog/select shapes remain unchanged. Image parts require message.images.v1 and all existing file gates. Media references require session.media.v1/current reader and never grant independent export/download authority. Changes and message previews are bounded current-reader queries. Forks require session.fork.v1 and preserve source session_id, exact anchor/workspace and original-once partial outcomes. Runtime validators enforce cross-field identities, byte/pixel limits and current authorization. Fragmented projected payloads are at most 2 MiB.

messagePreview.description: Exact authorized persisted visible subset; <=32768 UTF-8 text bytes and <=48KiB serialized payload. Image/file-only messages retain real anchors with text=null/shareable=false. Share confirmation requires unchanged current-reader authorization; no invented text.

hostForkReceiptPayload.description: Negotiated session.fork.v1 only. Envelope session_id always remains the source; child differs from source. Runtime enforces exact anchor/workspace, original-once journal, monotone retained outcome, child catalog identity and checkpoint evidence. Unknown outcome must never replay the native fork.

deviceForkReceiptPayload.description: Negotiated session.fork.v1 only. Envelope session_id always remains the source; child differs from source. Runtime enforces exact anchor/workspace, original-once journal, monotone retained outcome, child catalog identity and checkpoint evidence. Unknown outcome must never replay the native fork.

changesPage.description: Current configured-workspace Git HEAD to tracked index/worktree snapshot, never attributed to a turn. Maximum 32768 serialized UTF-8 bytes per page; version/manifest and connection-local cursors expire after 30 seconds. Runtime checks current reader/grant, exact source and byte budgets.

changesPatch.description: At most 16384 serialized UTF-8 bytes per page and 20000 lines across the bounded snapshot. Byte-exact full copy only when complete, nonbinary, not partial, with no next cursor and exact UTF-8 patch bytes.

mediaResultPayload.description: Source name and size must exactly equal the current reference manifest. No unavailable/directory source, native attachment identity, path or URL. A source reference is not export or download authority.

visibleMediaReference.description: Versioned visible-event provenance, not download authority. At most 16 MiB, 32 million pixels and 16384 pixels per dimension; runtime validates event/manifest digests, current reader sync/epoch, MIME, bytes and independently authorized export/download.

directoryMetadata.description: Plain untrusted native projection names, never paths or first-message fallbacks. Runtime enforces scalar Unicode, <=256 UTF-16 code units and <=1024 UTF-8 bytes; title source/cut describe cached or sequenced evidence, not live freshness.

hostObservations.description: Optional host.observations.v1, installation-only, current connection/epoch. Self-reported fixed native operations; never authority or command acceptance. Runtime validators also check unique cells, histogram arithmetic and monotone counter deltas.

fileMessageReconcileToHost.description: Host-only message.files.reconcile.v1 query for an already reserved original. Digest remains that of message.submit. It cannot admit a new native prompt. Phone clients cannot send this frame.

hostSessionCatalog.description: Identifier-only legacy shape unless session.metadata.v1 is negotiated and metadata_version=1 is explicit. Version remains invariant across a catalog chunk sequence. Names do not grant session.metadata.read or replace current authorization.
